movies.title: Go Down, Death!
movies.tagline: Inspired by James Weldon Johnson's poem.
movies.description: A juke-joint boss schemes to frame a new preacher who is drawing away his customers, and his foster mother pays the price when she tries to stop him. Inspired by James Weldon Johnson's poem.
movies.credits: Directed by Spencer Williams · Starring Myra D. Hemmings · Samuel H. James · Eddye L. Houston · Spencer Williams
movies.license: Public domain in the United States
movies.advisory: A fatal assault on an elderly woman; images of Hell with brief nudity (clips from the 1911 Italian film L'Inferno).

movies.title: Dirty Gertie from Harlem U.S.A.
movies.tagline: Harlem's hottest star heads for the islands.
movies.description: A Harlem nightclub star flees to a Caribbean island resort to headline its revue, where she toys with the men around her while missionaries watch her every move and a jilted lover tracks her down.
movies.credits: Directed by Spencer Williams · Starring Francine Everett · Don Wilson · Katherine Moore · Spencer Williams
movies.license: Public domain in the United States
movies.advisory: A woman is murdered by a former lover; sexual themes.

movies.title: Juke Joint
movies.tagline: Two con men. One beauty contest. No money.
movies.description: Two broke con men pose as Hollywood acting coaches to win free room and board, then coach their landlady's daughter for a beauty contest, until her father plans a victory party at a rough juke joint.
movies.credits: Directed by Spencer Williams · Starring Spencer Williams · July Jones · Inez Newell
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: Souls of Sin
movies.tagline: Three roommates, one Harlem basement.
movies.description: Three roommates share a Harlem basement apartment: a small-time gambler, a hard-luck writer and a young blues singer from the South, whose fortunes split when the gambler takes a job fencing stolen jewelry.
movies.credits: Directed by Powell Lindsay · Starring Savannah Churchill · William Greaves · Jimmy Wright · Powell Lindsay
movies.license: Public domain in the United States
movies.advisory: Gun violence (a fatal shooting); gambling and crime.

movies.title: Go West
movies.tagline: A drifter, a cow and a thousand steers.
movies.description: A drifter with no luck heads west, takes a ranch job and befriends a cow named Brown Eyes, then has to herd a thousand steers through downtown Los Angeles.
movies.credits: Directed by Buster Keaton · Starring Buster Keaton · Howard Truesdale · Kathleen Myers
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: Battling Butler
movies.tagline: He's not a boxer. He just plays one.
movies.description: A pampered rich kid pretends to be a champion boxer to win a mountain girl's family over, until he has to step into the ring for real.
movies.credits: Directed by Buster Keaton · Starring Buster Keaton · Sally O'Neil · Snitz Edwards
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: Topper Returns
movies.tagline: The victim wants her killer caught.
movies.description: A murdered heiress's ghost drags the timid Cosmo Topper into solving her own killing in a spooky mansion full of trapdoors and suspects.
movies.credits: Directed by Roy Del Ruth · Starring Joan Blondell · Roland Young · Carole Landis · Eddie "Rochester" Anderson
movies.license: Public domain in the United States
movies.advisory: Period racial stereotyping in the comic scenes with the chauffeur.

movies.title: Made for Each Other
movies.tagline: Married in a week. Tested for a lifetime.
movies.description: A young lawyer and the woman he marries after a whirlwind week face money troubles, a meddling mother and a desperate race to save their baby's life.
movies.credits: Directed by John Cromwell · Starring Carole Lombard · James Stewart · Charles Coburn
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: Quicksand
movies.tagline: Twenty dollars. One bad night. No way out.
movies.description: A garage mechanic borrows twenty dollars from the till to impress a girl, and every lie he tells to cover it sinks him deeper into crime.
movies.credits: Directed by Irving Pichel · Starring Mickey Rooney · Jeanne Cagney · Peter Lorre
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: Terror by Night
movies.tagline: A diamond, a night train, a killer aboard.
movies.description: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson guard a priceless diamond on the overnight express to Edinburgh, but a killer is already aboard.
movies.credits: Directed by Roy William Neill · Starring Basil Rathbone · Nigel Bruce · Alan Mowbray
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: Captain Kidd
movies.tagline: The King's pirate has his own plans.
movies.description: The notorious pirate William Kidd talks his way into the King's service as a treasure-ship escort, planning to rob it, but one of his crew has a score to settle.
movies.credits: Directed by Rowland V. Lee · Starring Charles Laughton · Randolph Scott · Barbara Britton
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: Of Human Bondage
movies.tagline: The role that made Bette Davis a star.
movies.description: A shy medical student with a club foot falls hopelessly for a cruel London waitress in the role that made Bette Davis a star.
movies.credits: Directed by John Cromwell · Starring Leslie Howard · Bette Davis · Frances Dee
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: The Blue Angel
movies.tagline: Falling in love again, with Marlene Dietrich.
movies.description: A strict schoolteacher goes to a cabaret to catch his students and falls for its singer, Lola Lola, a love that costs him everything. Marlene Dietrich's breakthrough.
movies.credits: Directed by Josef von Sternberg · Starring Emil Jannings · Marlene Dietrich
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: Nanook of the North
movies.tagline: A year at the edge of the Arctic.
movies.description: Robert Flaherty's landmark portrait of an Inuit family's year on the Hudson Bay coast: hunting, travel and building an igloo against the Arctic cold.
movies.credits: Directed by Robert J. Flaherty · Featuring Allakariallak
movies.license: Public domain in the United States
movies.advisory: Real animal hunting; some scenes were staged by the filmmaker.

movies.title: Reefer Madness
movies.tagline: The scare film that became a cult comedy.
movies.description: A school principal warns parents about 'the burning weed' in the cult-classic scare film that became a midnight-movie comedy.
movies.credits: Directed by Louis J. Gasnier · Starring Dorothy Short · Kenneth Craig · Lillian Miles
movies.license: Public domain in the United States
movies.advisory: Drug use, a killing, a suicide and an attempted sexual assault.

movies.title: Salt of the Earth
movies.tagline: When the miners can't strike, their wives do.
movies.description: When Mexican-American zinc miners in New Mexico strike and an injunction bars them from the picket line, their wives take their place.
movies.credits: Directed by Herbert J. Biberman · Starring Rosaura Revueltas · Juan Chacón · Will Geer
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: Let There Be Light
movies.tagline: John Huston's long-suppressed film on war trauma.
movies.description: John Huston follows soldiers treated for psychological trauma at an Army hospital after World War II, a film the Army withheld from the public until 1980.
movies.credits: Directed by John Huston · Narrated by Walter Huston · Music by Dimitri Tiomkin · Produced by the U.S. Army Signal Corps
movies.license: U.S. government work — public domain in the United States
movies.advisory: Real psychiatric patients describing wartime trauma.

movies.title: The Negro Soldier
movies.tagline: Black Americans in every war the nation fought.
movies.description: Framed as a church sermon, this Army film traces Black Americans' service from the Revolution to World War II and follows a recruit through training.
movies.credits: Directed by Stuart Heisler · Written by Carlton Moss · Produced by Frank Capra for the U.S. War Department
movies.license: U.S. government work — public domain in the United States
movies.advisory: Depicts the segregated wartime Army; real combat footage.

shows.title: Apollo: The Mission Films
shows.tagline: The Moon missions, in NASA's own films.
shows.description: NASA's own films of the Apollo flights, from the first crewed test in Earth orbit to the last lunar landing.
shows.credits: Produced for NASA (NASA Manned Spacecraft Center and A-V Corporation, Houston)
shows.license: U.S. government work — public domain in the United States

episodes.name: The Flight of Apollo 7
episodes.summary: The first crewed Apollo flight: Schirra, Eisele and Cunningham spend eleven days testing the command module in Earth orbit.

episodes.name: Apollo 8: Go for TLI
episodes.summary: Borman, Lovell and Anders become the first humans to leave Earth orbit and circle the Moon on Christmas 1968.

episodes.name: Apollo 10: To Sort Out the Unknowns
episodes.summary: The full dress rehearsal for a landing takes the lunar module within nine miles of the Moon's surface.

episodes.name: The Eagle Has Landed: The Flight of Apollo 11
episodes.summary: Launch, landing and moonwalk of Armstrong, Aldrin and Collins, told through television, film and photographs from the mission.

episodes.name: Apollo 12: Pinpoint for Science
episodes.summary: Conrad and Bean land beside the Surveyor 3 probe and set up the first long-term science station on the Moon.

episodes.name: Apollo 14: Mission to Fra Mauro
episodes.summary: Alan Shepard returns to space to explore the Fra Mauro highlands with Edgar Mitchell, while Stuart Roosa orbits above.

episodes.name: Apollo 15: In the Mountains of the Moon
episodes.summary: The first lunar rover carries Scott and Irwin across the Hadley-Apennine region beneath the Moon's highest mountains.

episodes.name: Apollo 16: Nothing So Hidden
episodes.summary: Young and Duke explore the Descartes highlands by rover while Mission Control and scientists follow every step.

episodes.name: Apollo 17: On the Shoulders of Giants
episodes.summary: The last Apollo landing: Cernan and Schmitt spend three days in the Taurus-Littrow valley as the program comes to a close.

shows.title: Sherlock Holmes
shows.tagline: The game is afoot, every week.
shows.description: Ronald Howard plays a young, easygoing Sherlock Holmes solving Victorian London mysteries with Dr. Watson in this 1950s syndicated series.
shows.credits: Produced by Sheldon Reynolds · Starring Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford, Archie Duncan
shows.license: Public domain in the United States

episodes.name: The Case of the Cunningham Heritage
episodes.summary: Newly returned from Afghanistan, Dr. Watson meets Sherlock Holmes and joins him to clear a young woman found beside a murdered man.

episodes.name: The Case of Lady Beryl
episodes.summary: Lady Beryl confesses to a murder, but Holmes doubts her story and recreates the crime to find the truth.

episodes.name: The Case of the Pennsylvania Gun
episodes.summary: Holmes and Watson travel to Sussex to investigate a squire's death by sawn-off shotgun, in a loose adaptation of The Valley of Fear.

episodes.name: The Case of the Texas Cowgirl
episodes.summary: A cowgirl from a visiting rodeo show asks Holmes to help her get rid of a dead body in her hotel room.

episodes.name: The Case of the Belligerent Ghost
episodes.summary: Watson claims a dead man attacked him, and Holmes links the 'ghost' to a museum art theft.

episodes.name: The Case of the Shy Ballerina
episodes.summary: When Watson's hat turns up at a diplomat's murder scene, Lestrade suspects the good doctor.

episodes.name: The Red-Headed League
episodes.summary: A shopkeeper is paid to copy the encyclopedia for a strange society of red-haired men, and Holmes smells a scheme.

episodes.name: The Case of the Laughing Mummy
episodes.summary: At a country manor, Holmes investigates an Egyptian mummy said to laugh in the night.

shows.title: Rocky Jones, Space Ranger
shows.tagline: Blast off with the Orbit Jet crew.
shows.description: Space Ranger Rocky Jones and the crew of the Orbit Jet patrol the United Worlds of the Solar System in this 1950s kids' space adventure.
shows.credits: Created by Roland Reed · Directed by Hollingsworth Morse · Starring Richard Crane, Scotty Beckett, Sally Mansfield
shows.license: Public domain in the United States

episodes.name: Beyond the Curtain of Space, Chapter I
episodes.summary: Chapter one of a three-part story: Space Ranger Rocky Jones and the Orbit Jet crew head out beyond a mysterious 'curtain' in space.

episodes.name: Beyond the Curtain of Space, Chapter II
episodes.summary: Chapter two: Rocky and his crew face new perils on the far side of the curtain of space.

episodes.name: Beyond the Curtain of Space, Chapter III
episodes.summary: Chapter three: Rocky races to resolve the crisis and bring his crew home.

episodes.name: Rocky's Odyssey, Chapter I
episodes.summary: Chapter one of a three-part story: Rocky and the Orbit Jet crew set out on a new mission far from Earth.

episodes.name: Rocky's Odyssey, Chapter II
episodes.summary: Chapter two: Rocky's odyssey through space grows more dangerous.

episodes.name: Rocky's Odyssey, Chapter III
episodes.summary: Chapter three: Rocky's odyssey reaches its climax.

shows.title: Life with Elizabeth
shows.description: Betty White stars as a scatterbrained young wife whose everyday mishaps exasperate her husband in three short comic incidents per episode.
shows.credits: Created by George Tibbles · Starring Betty White, Del Moore · Narrated by Jack Narz · Bandy Productions / Guild Films
shows.license: Public domain in the United States

shows.title: Flip the Frog
shows.description: The first six cartoons from Ub Iwerks, co-creator of Mickey Mouse, starring his cheerful, rubbery frog in the early days of sound cartoons.
shows.credits: Produced and drawn by Ub Iwerks · Celebrity Productions (Pat Powers) · Released by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer
shows.license: Public domain in the United States

episodes.name: Fiddlesticks
episodes.summary: Flip dances and plays piano with a violin-playing mouse at a woodland concert in the first Flip cartoon.

episodes.name: Flying Fists
episodes.summary: Flip takes on a much bigger opponent in a knockabout boxing match.

episodes.name: The Village Barber
episodes.summary: Flip's barbershop turns into chaos when his customers get more than a trim.

episodes.name: Little Orphan Willie
episodes.summary: A stork leaves a mischievous orphan on Flip's doorstep on a snowy night.

episodes.name: The Cuckoo Murder Case
episodes.summary: A stormy night and a spooky house send Flip on a ghoulish murder mystery.

episodes.name: Puddle Pranks
episodes.summary: Flip woos a sweetheart frog in and around the pond.

shows.title: Why We Fight
shows.tagline: Frank Capra's wartime series for the U.S. Army.
shows.description: Frank Capra's seven-film U.S. Army series explaining the road to World War II, built from newsreels, captured footage and animated maps.
shows.credits: Directed by Frank Capra, Anatole Litvak · Narrated by Walter Huston · Music by Dimitri Tiomkin · Produced by the U.S. War Department
shows.license: U.S. government work — public domain in the United States
shows.advisory: Wartime propaganda with racist caricatures of Japanese people; real combat footage.

episodes.name: Prelude to War
episodes.summary: Capra frames the war as a clash between a free world and a slave world, tracing how fascism rose in Germany, Italy and Japan.

episodes.name: The Nazis Strike
episodes.summary: Germany's rearmament and expansion from the Rhineland to the invasion of Poland, told through newsreels and animated maps.

episodes.name: Divide and Conquer
episodes.summary: The 1940 campaigns in Denmark, Norway, the Low Countries and France, ending with the fall of Paris.

episodes.name: The Battle of Britain
episodes.summary: Outnumbered, the Royal Air Force and Britain's civilians withstand the Luftwaffe's 1940 air campaign.

episodes.name: The Battle of Russia, Part 1
episodes.summary: Russia's history of repelling invaders sets up Germany's 1941 assault and the defense of Moscow.

episodes.name: The Battle of Russia, Part 2
episodes.summary: The siege of Leningrad and the turning point at Stalingrad.

episodes.name: The Battle of China
episodes.summary: Japan's invasion of China, the bombing of cities and the long Chinese resistance.

episodes.name: War Comes to America
episodes.summary: How American public opinion moved from isolationism to war between 1931 and Pearl Harbor.

shows.title: WWII Combat Reports
shows.tagline: Filmed under fire by the men who were there.
shows.description: Official combat documentaries shot by U.S. service cameramen, from Midway and Tarawa to Iwo Jima, including John Ford's and John Huston's war films.
shows.credits: Directed by John Ford, John Huston, William Wyler and U.S. armed-forces combat cameramen
shows.license: U.S. government work — public domain in the United States
shows.advisory: Real combat footage, including the dead and wounded.

episodes.name: The Battle of Midway
episodes.summary: Shot by John Ford's Navy camera crew during the Japanese attack on Midway Island in June 1942, in Technicolor.

episodes.name: Report from the Aleutians
episodes.summary: John Huston records the building of an airfield on Adak and bombing missions against Japanese-held Kiska.

episodes.name: The Memphis Belle: A Story of a Flying Fortress
episodes.summary: William Wyler flies with a B-17 crew on its 25th and final mission over Germany.

episodes.name: With the Marines at Tarawa
episodes.summary: Marine combat cameramen film the bloody November 1943 assault on Betio atoll; Academy Award winner.

episodes.name: Attack! The Battle for New Britain
episodes.summary: Army Signal Corps photographers follow the December 1943 landings at Arawe and Cape Gloucester in New Britain.

episodes.name: The Battle of San Pietro
episodes.summary: John Huston's unflinching record of the costly December 1943 fight for an Italian hill village.

episodes.name: To the Shores of Iwo Jima
episodes.summary: Navy, Marine and Coast Guard cameramen cover the invasion of Iwo Jima in color, including the flag raising.

episodes.name: Fury in the Pacific
episodes.summary: Joint Army-Navy-Marine film of the 1944 assaults on Peleliu and Angaur, shot by combat cameramen landing with the troops.

shows.title: Caminandes
shows.description: Koro, a stubborn Patagonian llama, schemes his way past fences, highways and one very pesky penguin in these dialogue-free cartoon shorts inspired by classic Chuck Jones gags.
shows.credits: Created by Pablo Vazquez · Produced by Blender Institute · Music by Jan Morgenstern (eps 1-2) · Torin Borrowdale (ep 3)

episodes.name: Llama Drama
episodes.summary: Koro the llama just wants to cross a lonely Patagonian highway, but the road has other ideas.

episodes.name: Gran Dillama
episodes.summary: Koro spots greener grass on the far side of an electric fence and tries every trick to get there.

episodes.name: Llamigos
episodes.summary: Winter in Patagonia: Koro battles Oti, a pesky penguin, over the very last tasty berry.

shows.title: Blender Open Shorts
shows.description: A collection of award-winning animated shorts from Amsterdam's Blender Studio, from painterly space fables to slapstick rocket rides, each made entirely with free software.
shows.credits: Produced by Blender Studio (Blender Institute / Blender Foundation) · Directed by Beorn Leonard · Hjalti Hjalmarsson · Daniel Martinez Lara · Rik Schutte · Andy Goralczyk

episodes.name: Glass Half
episodes.summary: Two amateur art critics bicker their way through a gallery, causing chaos for everyone else, until they finally find a piece they both love.

episodes.name: The Daily Dweebs
episodes.summary: In 1950s American suburbia, a mischievous pet named Dixey has a very bad day with a backyard chicken.

episodes.name: Hero
episodes.summary: Rendered as a living sketchbook, a soldier and a mysterious rival clash in a dazzling 2D-in-3D action showdown.

episodes.name: Coffee Run
episodes.summary: Fueled by caffeine, a young woman sprints through the bittersweet memories of a past relationship.

episodes.name: WING IT!
episodes.summary: An uptight engineer's day goes sideways when an overeager wannabe pilot launches them both skyward in an out-of-control space shuttle.

episodes.name: Singularity
episodes.summary: When a cosmic event swallows his icy home, a small space critter seeks refuge among luminous creatures watched over by a mysterious celestial being.
